keyUnavailableText: The key for your encrypted data is not available right now. Your data is safe — try again in a moment or restart your device.
unreadableTitle: Old data could not be read
unreadableText: Your previous data could no longer be decrypted on this device and was set aside. Restore it from a backup (Settings → Data).
backupIntro: Backup: all your data, encrypted in one file — for a new phone or just in case. It cannot be read without the password.
backupPassphraseCreateHint: Choose a password for the backup. It cannot be restored without it — keep it safe!
backupRestoreConfirmText: All plans, workouts and settings on this device will be replaced by the backup.
backupTooNew: This backup is from a newer app version. Please update the app.
backupWrongApp: This is not a Fitness backup.
